200
Returned if Tenable PCI ASV successfully retrieved the disputes for the specified PCI attestation.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
object (Response-Pagination)
An object containing pagination information for the current result set.
Array of objects (Response-DisputeList)
An array of PCI ASV dispute objects.
— 400 Returned if you do not have a license to use Tenable PCI ASV.
— 403
Returned if you do not have the required permissions to view the list of disputes for the specified
attestation.

— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable PCI ASV.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
